default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16); it places the view's node (js/view/message.js).

person.$comment: A conversation between people (D31 inventory §3: people.js is a template, not a tag); it places js/view/person.js's node.

accessibility.x-keys: A message is an article named «Помощник» or «Вы» (the template person: the author or «Вы»); a pending answer is aria-busy. Copy, rating, sources and footnotes are native buttons with names; a footnote opens the sources at its source and focuses it; the result of copy and rating is said by a polite region in the action row; a failure and a lost connection are role=alert. In the «why» card Enter sends and Escape puts it away; in a brief Enter in «Свой вариант» answers; in the editor of the template person Enter saves, Shift+Enter breaks the line and Escape cancels; the delete question takes the focus on «Отмена». Past 80 % of display.editLimit the editor shows its count, described to the field and spoken only when a threshold is crossed; a refused save is role=alert. A divider (display.divider, display.day) is role=separator named by its words. Among people (1.4.0): the word beside a name («ИИ», «Агент», «Бот») is text, never colour alone; a reaction's pill is a pressed button named «Реакция 👍, 3, ваша»; the picker opens on its first emoji, arrows move, Escape closes it and returns the focus to its tool; a quote is a button named with its author and line; «Показать полностью» carries aria-expanded. An author's sf-avatar is inert and hidden: not a Tab stop in a feed.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-chat-message for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20). The 0.3 general sf-chat-action {action, ...} is split by verb (vocabulary 1.1.5 §5.1); every row needs the element's detail adapter (sfAliasAdapters), which makes the 0.3 detail from the new one.

the 0.3 {action: check, id}; the element's adapter (sfAliasAdapters) puts action back
the 0.3 {action: feedback, id, value}, or {action: feedback-send, id, reason, note} when the rating carries a reason or a note; the element's adapter (sfAliasAdapters) puts action back
the 0.3 {action: feedback-skip, id} for kind rate; the element's adapter (sfAliasAdapters) puts action back
the 0.3 {action: feedback-draft, id, reason, note}; the element's adapter (sfAliasAdapters) puts action back
the 0.3 {action: sources, id, open} for kind sources; edit and delete (the template person) send no old event; the element's adapter (sfAliasAdapters) puts action back
the 0.3 {action: copy, id, done}; the element's adapter (sfAliasAdapters) puts action back
the 0.3 {action: brief-answer, id, text}; the element's adapter (sfAliasAdapters) puts action back
the 0.3 property view (what the window knows), renamed: view is a name the base reserves; the old property reads and writes display

x-summary: One chat message: an assistant's answer with its markup, sources, verification, notices, proposal, rating and task brief, or its wait; a person's question with its files; or, in the template person, a message of a conversation between people. It reports what a person does; the host decides what it means.

x-source.converted: by hand (D31 step 5): convert-1.3.8.mjs reads stand 17's output, which has no chat component

x-renamed: properties.view → the setting display (view is a name the base reserves, §3.1); the old property a dated setting alias until 2026-12-01

events.sf-chat-action {action, ...} → one event per verb (vocabulary §5.1 one name per verb), the old name a dated split alias until 2026-12-01 whose adapter puts action back: retry {id} → retry {id}; check {id} → check {id}; feedback {id, value} → rate {id, value}; feedback-send {id, reason, note} → rate {id, value: down, reason, note}; feedback-skip {id} → cancel {id, kind: rate}; feedback-draft {id, reason, note} → drafted; sources {id, open} → toggle {id, kind: sources, open}; copy {id, done} → copied {id, done}; brief-answer {id, text} → submit {id, text}

the template person (ui-chat people.js, the pilot's renderPersonMessage, which had no element): edit → save {id, values: {body}}, delete → delete {ids}, retry {clientKey} → retry {key}, retry-file {messageId, fileKey} → retry {id, key, kind: file}, edit-start / edit-cancel → toggle {kind: edit, open}, delete-ask / delete-cancel → toggle {kind: delete, open}; new names only, nothing to alias

words: the message's keys of ui-chat's strings.js → lang/<locale>.json runtime words, the dotted key in kebab-case (stage.queued → stage-queued, brief.otherLabel → brief-other-label); the view keeps calling ctx.words with the 0.3 keys and the element maps them (wordName)

css: component/chat/css/chat.css and people.css → js/templates/default.css; the --sf-chat--* tokens → --sf-chat-message--*, set on .sf-chat-message-host (and .sf-chat-surface, :host for a page or a widget without the element) instead of :root; five public variables --sf-chat-message-<name> under the ones a host adapted
x-decisions: version: 0.3.1 in simai/ui-chat → 1.0.0 here: the first release in ui-pro, with the events renamed under dated aliases (simai.linkage 1.0.0: the files changed).

shape: a leaf (D31 inventory §3). sf-message-log stays a chat-agnostic feed; the window sets log.renderMessage to place an sf-chat-message per message (or to call the exported renderMessage for the widget), so the chat's fields (sources, verification, stage, rating, brief) never enter the shared log.

the view stays plain DOM (js/view/message.js, js/view/person.js, the 0.3 render.js and people.js with their imports changed), built once per change and handed to Lit as one node, as ui-chat's ChatElement did: an open «why» card, a brief's typed answer and a proposal's pressed card keep their nodes and focus, and the site widget and the pilot, which have no Framework runtime, can call renderMessage from a pinned ui-pro revision.

people: the template person (D31 inventory §3: a second template of the same component, not a tag), selected by the attribute template=person; display carries own, first, last, showName, editing and askDelete as people.js's view did.

file chip: sf-chat-composer owns it (js/templates/parts.js, step 4); the message imports it by relative path, as sf-data-view imports from table, renders it into its DOM with Lit and adds, for a sent file with href, the download link and the HEAD check: on 404 or 410 the name loses its link and the line says «Файл удалён» (role=status). The composer's files are not changed; its chip rules and the message's are both unscoped class markup, so the message scopes its own to .sf-chat-message and .sf-chat-person.

sanitize: SF.sanitizeHtml(html, {codeLanguage: true, document}) and SF.safeHref, Core's (src/core/js/sanitize.js, made from ui-chat's copy: the same allow-list, incl. h2 h3 h4 del). 1.0.1: framework.lock.json pins ui-source 465fbee (pair ui-194f75ac620f), which has them since 4d711d2 (pair ui-89834691fb9d), so the component's copy js/view/sanitize.js and the fallback are removed; message.js imports core/js/sanitize.js, which publishes SF.sanitizeHtml and SF.safeHref on a page where core.js has not run and never replaces Core's, and calls SF's. The probe's sanitize cases (p1, p9) run against Core's.

proposal: the message places sf-change-confirm (attributes heading, heading-level 2, change-id, state, expires-at, changes as JSON, accept-text «Подтвердить», decline-text «Отменить»), one card per code kept across redraws; its sf-change-confirm-answer bubbles through the message to the window, which sends the proposal's command. The chat's other words for the card («Отменено», the expiry sentence) are registered by the window (ui-chat chat-core/larena.js registerLarenaWords), not by the message: registering another component's words is a page's act.

events: sf-chat-action {action, ...} is split by verb (vocabulary §5.1): retry, check, rate, cancel, toggle, submit (§5, chat 1.1.3 check) and two facts of the chat's own, drafted and copied (own-verb). copy and sources are local (D31 inventory §1) but stay as facts, since the window keeps an open sources list across redraws. The old name follows until 2026-12-01 as split rows whose adapter makes the 0.3 detail; the person's events had no element before and have no alias.

display: the 0.3 property view, renamed because view is a name the base reserves; a dated setting alias keeps el.view until 2026-12-01. Setting message, display or features (even the same object again) redraws the view, as the 0.3 setters did.

words: lang/ru.json and lang/en.json, runtime only, ru the source language; the view asks for the 0.3 dotted keys and the element maps them to the kebab names (wordName). The copy label of a highlighted code block is the word code-copy.

network: host-only. The one request is the HEAD check of a sent file's own download address before following it (Mirai24 27.10: a file deleted from «Мои файлы» keeps its attachment); the address is the host's, never built here.

first paint (§5.4): no late data. The message comes with the host's state; the printed markup is the message as drawn. The element reads no clock: times are the message's own (finished_at, createdAt, limit_resets_at, read_at) in the reader's zone, so a snapshot depends on the zone it was taken in (the examples avoid times).

css-variables: five public variables in the Framework's form (single dash, read with the token as fallback, never set): the reading column, the text, the muted text, the bubble and the edges. Their fallbacks are the tokens chat.css gave the same places.
standard 1.4 (2026-10-29): component.json and examples.json in the 1.4 form, the other files generated by ui-source scripts/generate-component-files.mjs.

steps (1.1.0, API.md v1.3 proposed): part of sf-chat-message, not a component of its own: they are a part of an answer's lifecycle (the stage line's place while it is written, a folded line above it after), have no API of their own but a toggle the host remembers (display.steps_open), and the site widget, which calls renderMessage without the runtime, must draw them too. Running: one line «Работаю · 1 мин 12 с · 4 шага» with a spinner (still under prefers-reduced-motion), the time ticking each second from the first step's started_at (else created_at) by a clock the rendering stops when let go (disposeRendering) and starts again when its element comes back (resumeRendering); the list has the running step last. Final: «Сделано за 1 мин 40 с · 4 шага» (answered) or «Прервано…» (an answer that did not come), folded; a failed answer with a failed step keeps the list open; a step or line without its times has no time. Not a live region: rebuilt with its message in a busy article, so the window's one announcer says the step (stepsSay), never the clock. Without steps the stage line is unchanged.

preview (1.1.0, API.md v1.3 proposed): a source with a same-origin preview_url (proposed.js sameOriginHref: root-relative or the page's origin, http(s)) asks for it from its footnote and from its title in the list (a site keeps its link) with the event open {id, kind: preview, source}, cancelable: the host that shows it cancels, and only then does the footnote not open the list. Without preview_url, or with one of another origin, a footnote opens the list as before.

an answer's files (1.1.0, API.md v1.3 proposed): «Что готово» under an answered message, a card per attachment: icon by type, name, size and extension, «Просмотр» (the same open event; a new tab when nobody takes it) when it has a same-origin preview_url, «Скачать» (a download link, same-origin only) checked first with HEAD like a sent file's chip. Drawn as the chat's own markup, not sf-file-preview: that is a file row with download and remove, no preview action, and the widget has no runtime to place it.

words (1.1.0): a file found gone by the HEAD check says «Файл недоступен» (en «File unavailable»), not «Файл удалён»: the neutral word a people messenger (the Bitrix module) asked for, since the server may also refuse it for other reasons. Plural step counts are four words (steps-count-one, -few, -many, -other) chosen by Intl.PluralRules in the view, which the widget's words function can give as well.

proposed fields (1.1.0): every field proposed to Mirai24 as API.md v1.3 is read only in js/view/proposed.js (stepsOf, previewOf, previewTarget, deliverablesOf, PROPOSED_MESSAGE_FIELDS), so a renamed field changes one module; all optional, and a message without them draws exactly as 1.0.3 did.

people 1.2.0 (for sf-chat-window 1.3.0): display.conflict {deleted} draws the message as it is now with «Сообщение уже изменили» (or «уже удалили») above the editor, which keeps the typed text and offers «Оставить их» (edit-cancel) and «Заменить своим» (the same save); above the delete question the same line. The line is not a live region (the message is drawn again with it): the window says it once. display.divider unread draws «Новые» before the message in either template, as plain text in reading order, outside the article. message.authorAvatar (a host's picture) covers the initials beside the first of a run and falls back to them. Escape in the delete question takes it back, as «Отмена»; the edit and delete buttons carry classes sf-chat-person__edit and sf-chat-person__delete, the editor's sf-chat-person__edit-cancel and -save.

people 1.3.0 (for sf-chat-window 1.5.0): display.editLimit gives the editor sf-chat-composer's way of showing a limit: the same 80 % threshold and words, written here as people-edit-count and people-edit-too-long since a message has no composer to ask. Over the limit the form does not raise save and says people-edit-refused; no maxlength, so nothing typed or pasted is ever cut. Saving is not disabled: the button stays, so the refusal is what says why. display.day draws through renderDivider with display.divider, the same look, the day first; both are role=separator with aria-label. Without the new fields a message draws as before, but for that role on «Новые».

a document among people (1.4.0): the template default with display.document, not a third template. An assistant's message among people has every part of the default (steps, sources, files, rating, copy, waits, the proposal, the brief) and all of its code; a template would have had to repeat them or share them all, and the window's find, announcer and proposal code already read that article. The option only adds: the head (sign, name, word, «по просьбе»), the column's indent to where a person's text begins, the fold, the pills, the tools, the visible time and always-visible copy and rating. Without it the template draws byte for byte as before.

who speaks (1.4.0): message.speaker {kind, name} in the view's shape, not message.author: in the view author is the run key sf-message-log reads. sf-chat-window reads author.kind from its port message and hands speaker. A sign is the avatars' class markup with a sf-icon, since sf-avatar has no setting for a glyph (its placeholder is always person); the icons are neutral (auto_awesome, hub, bolt), never a face, and author's picture is not read for it. The word is sf-badge (non-interactive, what the Framework's label for a category is); sf-tag is built for selecting and removing.

sf-avatar for a person (1.4.0): the template person's own span goes where the element is given ctx.avatar; the widget and the pilot, which call the view without a runtime, keep the plain initials. sf-avatar's default template is a button named «Аватар», so in a feed it stays inert and aria-hidden: a Tab stop per run would be noise. A picture that fails to load: image-url is taken away and the initials come back, as the span did.

«по просьбе» (1.4.0): the word is «по просьбе {name}» and Russian wants the genitive; a component cannot inflect a name, so asked_by.name is drawn as given and the host gives the form to be read («Анны»).

folding (1.4.0): measured once placed (lines depend on the column), not estimated from characters. Budget 14 lines of the text's own line height, with two of grace; a table's region is outside the count and always stays; a proposal stands outside the text. Blocks past the budget get hidden, the one across it is cut to whole lines with a fade. Nothing to measure (no width): the text stays open. hidden also means the window's find does not see folded text until it is opened.

reactions (1.4.0): not optimistic; the pill is drawn from message.reactions only, display.reacting marks one as on its way (aria-busy, no second press), and a first reaction waits on a pill with no number. The picker is one row of six over the tools, under them where the feed's top would cut it; display.picker is the host's so a redraw keeps it. The tools are shown the one way the template person shows edit and delete: hover or focus where a pointer hovers, always on touch, 44 px under a finger; on touch they stand under the bubble so they do not squeeze it. With neither canReact nor canReply the two buttons of 1.2.0 stay exactly.

«⋯» (1.4.0): sf-context-menu made on the first press, waiting for the element (lazy), as sf-thread-list's. Edit on a document is not offered: a machine's text is not a person's to edit in place; delete is, where can_delete says so.

$comment: A message draws the Framework's plain markup: icon buttons (copy, rating,
a chip's remove), buttons (a brief's options, the «why» card, the person's
editor) and inputs («Свой вариант», the note of a rating); every glyph is a
Smart sf-icon, and a proposal is the package's sf-change-confirm. A tag it
renders is a tag it fetches. Code blocks go through SF.Highlight when the
page has it; the message does not bring it.
Among people an author is sf-avatar, or its class markup with a sign, the word
beside a name sf-badge and «⋯» sf-context-menu: only there, so lazily.

message.const: API.md Message for the template default: {id, role: user|assistant, status: queued|running|completed|partial|failed|refused|withheld|limit, stage, html, text, sources [{n, kind, title, url, excerpt, read_at}], verification, notices, proposal {code, title, state, expires_at, changes}, brief (v1.2 {decision: ask|card, lead, questions|card}), feedback, summary {text}, limit_resets_at, finished_at, attachments [{id, name, bytes, href}]; proposed as v1.3 (all optional): steps [{code, label, state: running|done|failed, started_at, finished_at}], sources[].preview_url (same origin), locator {from, to} (or {page}), mime, and an answer's attachments [{id, name, bytes, mime, href, preview_url}]}. For the template person: {id, body, authorName, createdAt, isEdited, isDeleted, canEdit, canDelete, files [{id, key, name, size, state, downloadUrl}], local {state, action, clientKey, body}}. Among people (1.4.0), either template: reactions [{emoji, count, mine}], reply_to {id, author: {name}, text, is_deleted}. With display.document: speaker {kind: assistant|agent|bot, name}, asked_by {name}, canDelete, is_deleted.

sanitize.const: message.html is cleaned by SF.sanitizeHtml (codeLanguage), Core's, with the allow-list: p br strong em code pre ul ol li blockquote a table thead tbody tr th td h2 h3 h4 del; links http, https, mailto or root-relative, with rel=noopener noreferrer nofollow and target=_blank.

brief.const: Live (display.brief.live) the brief asks: one question sends its option or own words at once; several are answered together, joined by «; » with «—» for a skipped optional one; the card sends its confirm word. Not live it is a record, the taken option marked from display.brief.answer. The lead, when given, stands for the html.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: fetching or polling the chat API
sending a rating, an answer or an edit

untrusted_inputs: message texts, source titles and excerpts (drawn as text)
download addresses (the host's, used as given)

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-chat-message for one chat message: a window places it in sf-message-log through the log's renderMessage hook; a page that shows one message (a preview) places it alone. The template person draws a conversation between people.
do_not: Do not stack sf-chat-message elements into a conversation yourself; sf-message-log keeps the reading position and the announcements
Do not put trusted markup into message.html; it is sanitized, and only the allow-list survives
Do not decide a proposal in the message; answer sf-change-confirm-answer in the window
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-chat-message></sf-chat-message> with element.message = {id: 'msg_03', role: 'assistant', status: 'completed', text: 'Ежегодный отпуск — 28 календарных дней.'}

accessibility.focus: A message is an article named «Помощник» or «Вы» (the template person: the author or «Вы»); a pending answer is aria-busy. Copy, rating, sources and footnotes are native buttons with names; a footnote opens the sources at its source and focuses it; the result of copy and rating is said by a polite region in the action row; a failure and a lost connection are role=alert. In the «why» card Enter sends and Escape puts it away; in a brief Enter in «Свой вариант» answers; in the editor of the template person Enter saves, Shift+Enter breaks the line and Escape cancels; the delete question takes the focus on «Отмена».

changes: moved from simai/ui-chat to ui-pro (D31): standard simai.smart-component 1.3.9, the element is made from component.json; the view (render.js, people.js as the template person, sanitize.js as a fallback) is the component's js/view; words in lang/; dated aliases in aliases.json; nothing imported from ui-chat
property view -> the setting display until 2026-12-01 (setting alias)
a file chip is sf-chat-composer's; a sent file keeps its download link and the «Файл удалён» check
The first-paint snapshot's sheets.json lists the utility sheets its markup uses (retaken on ui-source 5ba9399); no behaviour changed. Nothing to change for a host.

An answer's steps (API.md v1.3, proposed: steps): a compact line «Работаю · время · N шагов» while it is written, «Сделано за … · N шагов» after it, each opening the list; the event toggle {kind: steps} and display.steps_open. Without steps nothing changes.

A source with a same-origin preview_url asks for its preview from its footnote and its title: the new cancelable event open {id, kind: preview, source}; a host that shows it cancels it. Without preview_url nothing changes.
An answer's files (attachments on an assistant message): «Что готово» with a card per file, «Просмотр» and «Скачать».
A downloaded file found gone says «Файл недоступен» instead of «Файл удалён» (attachment-deleted). A host that looked for the old words looks for the new ones.

Template person: display.conflict {deleted} shows «Сообщение уже изменили» with the message as it is now over the kept typed text, «Оставить их» and «Заменить своим»; message.authorAvatar beside the first of a run; Escape cancels the delete question.
Both templates: display.divider unread draws «Новые» before the message. Without the new fields a message draws as before.
Template person: display.editLimit, the editor's limit: the count past 80 %, past the limit a save refused with a line and the typed text kept.
Both templates: display.day draws the words of a new day before the message, above «Новые»; both are role=separator (sf-chat-divider--day, sf-chat-divider--unread).
Template person: the avatar is the Framework's sf-avatar when the element draws it (the view without a runtime keeps the plain initials).

Both templates among people: message.reactions as pills, message.reply_to as a quote at the top; display.canReact and canReply replace the two buttons with reply, reaction and «⋯»; the events react, reply, open {kind: quote}, toggle {kind: react}.
Template default with display.document: a document without a bubble, who speaks (speaker, asked_by), a long text folded, stop on the message (canStop). Without these a message draws as before.

template.description: default: an assistant's answer or a person's question (API.md Message); person: a message of a conversation between people.
